articles.title: Kraken parent Payward seeks fresh funding at $20 billion valuation ahead of planned IPO
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator is pursuing a new fundraising round as it ramps up acquisitions across derivatives and stablecoins while laying the groundwork for a future public listing.

articles.title: Ripple raises $200 million from Neuberger Berman to expand its Ripple Prime platform
articles.snippet: Ripple announced its agreement with the global investment firm Monday, noting that Ripple Prime’s revenue has tripled in the last year, when. it acquired it for $1.25 billion.

articles.title: Circle raises $222 million for Arc, beats Q1 earnings estimates but misses on revenue
articles.snippet: Circle raised $222 million for its Arc blockchain token at a $3 billion valuation, drawing backing from BlackRock, Apollo and Bullish.

articles.title: Canton Network’s Digital Asset targets $2 billion valuation in a16z crypto-led raise: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: Sources familiar with the matter told Bloomberg the fundraiser is expected to close in the coming weeks and the final amount might vary.

articles.title: USDC issuer Circle raises $222M in Arc token presale valued at $3B
articles.snippet: Circle raised $222 million in an ARC token presale led by a16z Crypto as Q1 revenue hit $694 million and USDC circulation climbed to $77 billion.
